evidence.quote: Neuroimaging of Case 2
A: Electroencephalography six hours after onset, revealing spike and wave complex in the bilateral fronto-parieto-occipital lobes.
At 2.5 years post onset, she was readmitted to the emergency room of our hospital due to difficulty in speech without convulsive seizures.
EEG obtained six hours after onset showed spike and wave complexes in the bilateral fronto-parieto-occipital lobes (Figure 3A).
